findings.title: Runtime state artifacts in working tree block VM auto-deploy script

evidence.observation: auto-deploy.sh was introduced in commit 0e23775 and aborts execution if the working tree is dirty to prevent overwriting manual changes.

Working tree is currently dirty with untracked/modified runtime state files: data/self-improvement/review/evolution_summary.json, data/self-improvement/review/opportunities.jsonl, Missions/Engineering-Handoffs/, data/self-improvement/review/.evolution_cycle.lock, and data/self-improvement/review/mission_dispatch_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Add data/self-improvement/review/ and runtime handoff artifact paths to .gitignore so automated review cycles do not create a dirty working tree that halts automated VM pulls.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores automated GitHub-to-VM deployment pipeline reliability without manual git stash/clean operations.

findings.title: Systemd unit name drift between repository deploy configurations and live runtime services

evidence.observation: Commit 0e23775 explicitly notes that deploy/xo-bot.service does not match the live unit tg-xo.service targeted by telegram-bots/xo/app.py, and starfleet-slack-bot.service is running live with no unit file in deploy/.

proposed_action.description: Reconcile unit definitions in deploy/ with systemctl list-units output on the VM, updating auto-deploy-services.conf and aligning filenames.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures all intended backend services automatically restart with accurate systemd unit targets following auto-deploy pulls.
